cases.answer: The findings were discordant. In postmortem frontal cortex from C9ORF72 FTD/ALS patients, phosphorylated PKR (p-PKR T446) was increased by immunohistochemistry (especially in large pyramidal neurons; n=4 per genotype) and phosphorylated eIF2α (Ser51, normalized to total eIF2α) was significantly increased by western blot (6 controls, 6 patients), indicating PKR/eIF2α pathway activation in patient brain. In contrast, in two lines of C9ORF72 patient-derived iPSC motor neurons versus their isogenic controls, the authors detected no differences in either phosphorylated PKR or phosphorylated eIF2α at 38 days of differentiation. The authors interpret this by suggesting the PKR/eIF2α-dependent ISR 'possibly gets activated in C9ORF72 patients in a later stage of disease pathogenesis' that young in-vitro neurons have not reached. This explanation should be read cautiously: it is a speculation (worded 'possibly'), not directly tested, and rests on a very small sample (only two iPSC-MN lines, n=4 IHC and n=6 blot samples for cortex, with noted heterogeneity of eIF2α protein levels among patients). Alternative explanations (immaturity/artefact of the iPSC model, cell-type or regional differences, or that cortical ISR activation is not driven by the antisense mechanism studied) are not excluded, and the discordance limits how strongly the model-system mechanism can be claimed to operate in patients.

claims.claim: Phosphorylated PKR is increased in the frontal cortex of C9ORF72 FTD/ALS patients
claims.quote: Immunohis- tochemistry staining showed that the level of phosphorylated PKR is increased in the frontal cortex, especially in the large pyramidal neurons, of patients carrying C9ORF72 repeat expansions

claims.claim: Phosphorylated eIF2α normalized to total eIF2α is also significantly increased in patient frontal cortex
claims.quote: the level of phosphorylated eIF2α after normalizing to the total eIF2α level is also significantly increased, despite the heterogeneity of eIF2α protein levels in patients

claims.claim: No difference in p-PKR or p-eIF2α was seen in two lines of 38-day-old patient-derived motor neurons vs isogenic controls
claims.quote: we did not observe any differences in the levels of either phosphorylated PKR or phosphorylated eIF2α of 38- day- old neurons

claims.claim: The authors speculatively explain the discordance as late-stage activation of the pathway
claims.quote: suggesting that PKR/ eIF2α-dependent ISR pathway possibly gets activated in C9ORF72 patients in a later stage of disease pathogenesis.

claims.claim: Small samples underlie the human findings (n=4 IHC; 6 controls, 6 patients for blots)
